name: securacv_csi
description: SecuraCV WiFi CSI — the canary product's csi:: adapter over the canonical HAL in firmware/common/csi (csi_hal.cpp + csi_features.cpp, compiled by platformio.ini's build_src_filter). Privacy-preserving environmental sensing (motion / breathing / micro-activity) via subcarrier dynamics: no identifiers, no raw samples — only a 32-byte int8 feature vector per 1 s window.
